decisions.title: STORE_CREDIT disposition
decisions.accountableOwner: Product and Payments/Accounting Control; CFO/Controller approval
decisions.recommendation: Disable, hide, and reject server-side now; treat an internal liability ledger as a separate governed program.

decisions.title: Physical active-session boundary
decisions.accountableOwner: POS Operations Product Owner and Data/Platform Architect
decisions.recommendation: Use an explicit physical register/terminal claim with one active terminal session and one active drawer claim enforced in the database; cashier is the actor, not the physical lock.

decisions.title: First electronic provider rail
decisions.accountableOwner: Payments Product Owner, Treasury/Reconciliation, and Security
decisions.recommendation: Pilot one named provider in one country with sandbox, signed webhook/status query, reversal, statement feed, and kill switch.

decisions.title: Offline tender and risk policy
decisions.recommendation: Cash-only bounded pilot after G3/G4, with tenant/store/device/value/time/queue/session/country caps; no electronic offline without provider certification.

decisions.title: Supported hardware and browser matrix
decisions.recommendation: Certify a narrow named browser/OS/scanner/printer/drawer/terminal matrix first; fail all other combinations closed.

decisions.title: Returns and refund policy
decisions.accountableOwner: Retail Operations Product Owner, Controller, and Payments/Risk
decisions.recommendation: Approve line/quantity partial and full returns, supervised cross-shift handling, policy-bound cross-location, cash-availability, provider outcome states, fiscal corrections, fresh auth, and risk-based maker-checker.

decisions.title: Country, currency, tax, fiscal, and language scope
decisions.accountableOwner: Country Product Owner, Controller/Tax Counsel, and Localization Lead
decisions.recommendation: Certify one named launch country first with EN/FR, approved XAF/minor units, tax/fiscal labels, rounding, and receipt-correction rules; prohibit silent USD/0.01 fallbacks.

decisions.title: POS 9+ SLO and performance budgets
decisions.recommendation: Baseline on the approved hardware/network/catalog matrix, then approve percentile scan/search/render/charge/replay/recovery, availability, and error budgets.
